gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-kufam: Kufam reads like neon tubing, a single track width carrying generously open curves through every line. And Wallpoet above it stays bold and commanding, which makes the tubing look almost gentle by comparison.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-lexend: Approachable lowercase in Lexend comes out oversized, with open jaws on every curve. Wallpoet takes the top line with a bold, commanding presence, and the sans below it never swells where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca runs as one plain, unshaded line, its terminals stopping short of curling back in. And Wallpoet supplies the shout, bold and commanding, over a line that never swells.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-liter: Loud on top, level below: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, while Liter holds stroke contrast at exactly none. Its wide round mouths leave Wallpoet's commanding lines room to stand out.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mada: Mada reads approachable and modern, its curves refusing to close and its midzone towering, while Wallpoet leads with bold command. Give Mada a generous size and those open curves have room.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans reads modern and neutral, every curve given a generous opening and a high mean line crossing each word. Wallpoet delivers the bold, commanding line, and Martel Sans quietly carries the rest.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-matangi: Contemporary strokes in Matangi look like twine pressed into a flat surface. Wallpoet brings bold, commanding weight to the heading, and the hefty lowercase below it, left open in its round letters, holds its own.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro reads modern, with an open, welcoming gap in its c and a high-waisted lowercase. Page after page it stays gentle, a monotone line beside Wallpoet's bold command.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-michroma: Michroma reads contemporary and professional, giving each letter a wide berth and leaving daylight inside its curves. But Wallpoet does its best work up top, bold and commanding, while Michroma's tall-bodied lowercase excels further down.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre draws a monoline stroke from start to finish, with the weight of wire and an s that opens generously. Miriam Libre then follows Wallpoet's bold, commanding heading with a line that stays approachable and modern.
